title: Heterogeneous layer adaptive rescaler and profile tuning for FP8/INT8 calibration
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Problem: During FP8/INT8 calibration for several open models we observed model-specific activation tail behavior that breaks global per-tensor scale assumptions. Qwen exhibits long-tailed token activations in later transformer layers under code-generation prompts; Mistral has short but high-magnitude spikes localized to a few attention heads; Llama-family shows drifting channel-wise ranges across sequence length. These lead to accuracy regressions after quantization (measured by delta PPL and task-specific metrics).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible per-model calibration workflow that detects layer- and head-level outlier modes and emits a compatible quant profile for FP8 and INT8 runs
A lightweight adaptive rescaler that can be applied at compile-time or first-run calibration to fix layer-wise scale mismatches without full retraining

Automated accuracy validation harness that runs baseline (fp16) vs quantized (FP8/INT8) on standard eval sets for Llama, Mistral, Qwen and reports PPL / exact-match / BLEU / task-specific deltas <= configured thresholds
Integration tests showing zero increased tail latency and <3% throughput regression with rescaler enabled on our dedicated pools
Design review and security review completed; PRs merged and can be toggled by model flag in runtime-1.20
comments: 2025-09-18 Sofia Nguyen: Initial investigation notes attached. Ran small grid of per-layer histograms for qwen-7b-code and mistral-7b-instruct on a mix of code and instruction prompts. Observed two failure modes: persistent layer-wise offset drift (Llama) and rare extreme spikes in attention heads (Mistral/Qwen).

2025-09-25 Marco Ruiz: Prototype adaptive rescaler algorithm implemented — uses percentile-based clipping + multiplicative layer offset correction derived from calibration corpus. Early runs reduce measured per-layer scale variance by ~60% for qwen-7b-code. Saved prototype artifact to Drive.

2025-10-02 Priya Shah (ML Research): Reviewed prototype. Feedback: percentile clipping fixed many cases but hurt LM scoring on short-context prompts for Llama; recommend adding sequence-length-aware normalization and a lightweight per-channel fallback for critical layers. Suggested controlled A/B with our eval harness.

2025-10-09 Marco Ruiz: Extended prototype to support head-wise spike detection threshold and per-channel smoothing window. Added toggles: --rescale-mode={global,layer,channel} and --spike-threshold. Benchmarked on validation set: FP8 with rescaler reduced delta PPL from +10.8 to +2.1 on qwen-7b-code; INT8 improvements similar but require different clipping percentiles. Results uploaded to Drive link.

2025-10-16 Design review (Aisha Patel): UX for Console exposure decided — surface model flag in model catalog and per-deployment toggle with telemetry. Need to include clear rollback instructions and a cost-latency estimate in Console UI.

2025-10-22 Eng Infra (Benji Gomez): Build/CI notes — added quant-profile generation step to nightly calibration job. It runs per-model calibration then validation harness. Flagging heavy IO in calibration stage; suggested caching intermediate histograms in S3 and incremental recalibration to reduce cost.

2025-10-29 Marco Ruiz: Accuracy validation added to pipeline. For each candidate profile we run: (1) baseline fp16 inference, (2) quantized inference with rescaler, (3) compute PPL and task metrics. Created thresholds file: default_max_ppl_delta=3.0, max_exact_match_drop=1.5% for supervised tasks. Repository PR opened: #4821 (link above).

2025-11-03 QA (Lina Korchev): Ran cross-model fairness checks. Observed one regression: mistral-7b-dialog shows EM drop ~2.8% on a narrow intent dataset when aggressive head clipping enabled. Mitigation: add per-customer conservative profile and fallback to layer-only mode for dialog models. Added label 'conservative-profile-needed'.

2025-11-07 Marco Ruiz: Merged core runtime changes to feature branch. Added Canary rollout plan: small subset of dedicated nodes (5%) with canary profiles and continuous accuracy monitoring. Next steps: finalize Console UI copy, update documentation, and schedule runtime-1.20 internal alpha for 2025-11-20.
